title: Rescheduling a reliability test
passage:
Woman: We need the reliability chamber for three days, starting Wednesday. Is it available?
Man: Another team has booked it through Thursday. You could begin Friday morning, or use the smaller chamber on Wednesday.
Woman: The smaller one cannot hold all twelve samples. Let us choose Friday, and I will notify the project manager about the revised completion date.
Man: I will reserve the larger chamber for you. Please bring the test plan when you check in.
passageZh:
女：我們從星期三開始需要使用可靠度試驗箱三天。有空檔嗎？
男：另一個團隊已預約到星期四，包含星期四當天。你們可以星期五早上開始，或星期三用比較小的試驗箱。
女：小的那台放不下全部十二個樣品。我們選星期五，我會通知專案經理修改後的完成日期。
男：我會替你預約較大的試驗箱。登記使用時請帶測試計畫。
